blocks.text: The final section warns the Corinthians not to be unequally yoked with unbelievers (6:14-18). A series of rhetorical questions poses the incompatibility of righteousness with iniquity, light with darkness, Christ with Belial, and believers with unbelievers. The passage concludes with assertions that believers form a temple of the living God and that God will dwell in and walk among them. This unit functions as a boundary-setting exhortation, though its precise historical referent, its relationship to the surrounding appeal for openness, and the scope of its application remain disputed among interpreters.
